title: Function types
description: The shared vocabulary of demand and supply: loads need a function type, module channels provide one.

field.name: Name
field.loadTypesHint: The load types a need of this function may have. None ticked = any.
field.allowsCircuit: Several needs may share one channel
field.allowsCircuitHint: A circuit: e.g. lights and sockets yes, blinds and inputs no.
field.knxObjectsHint: The communication objects of a need of this function: each gets a group address in the KNX export.
field.activeHint: Inactive function types stay on existing needs but cannot be chosen for new needs or room templates.
